## Subsidiaries and assets[edit]


### CVS Pharmacy[edit]


Main article: CVS Pharmacy

CVS Pharmacy is one of the largest retail pharmacy chains in the United States, with 9,600 stores located in all 50 states,[59] the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico, operating primarily under the CVS Pharmacy, CVS, Longs Drugs, Navarro Discount Pharmacy and Drogaria Onofre names.[60] CVS Pharmacy fills more than one of every five prescriptions in the United States, and 85% of U.S. population lives within 10 miles of a CVS Pharmacy.[61] The ExtraCare loyalty program boasts over 70 million cardholders, making it the largest retail loyalty program in the country.[62]



### MinuteClinic[edit]


Main article: MinuteClinic


</fragment>
<fragment>
Following a period of growth in the 1980s and 1990s, CVS Corporation spun off from Melville in 1996, becoming a standalone company trading on the New York Stock Exchange as CVS.[6] In December 2017, CVS agreed to acquire Aetna for $69 billion[7][8][9] and completed the acquisition in November 2018.[10] Legal issues related to the merger were resolved in September 2019.[11] In February 2020, CVS Health announced changes to its board of directors, whose size was reduced from 16 to 13 directors.[12]


In 2021, CVS Health was ranked 4th on the Fortune 500 list,[13] and 7th on the *Fortune Global 500* list.[14]


On November 18, 2021, CVS Health announced that the company plans to close 900 stores over the next three years with closing due to begin in the spring of 2022.[15]
